title: Somebody Else
label: ch:bn-somebody-else
canDo: I can talk about a third person, choose the respectful form when I should, sort them by how far away they are, and say what is theirs.

payoff.summary: The third person arrives — graded for respect on the same ladder as তুমি and আপনি, and sorted by distance on the same heads as এই and ওই — and with it the possessive column reaches its third of six cells.
payoff.note: There was no third-person pronoun anywhere in the corpus, so every sentence a learner could build was about themselves or their listener and nobody could be talked about.
